title: Explicit coherent-family module presheaf and its shrinking
statement: Given a ringed space X, an arbitrary index type I, opens U i, module sheaves Fi i on Over (U i), and overlap isomorphisms φij, the explicit coherentOpenModulePresheaf has as its sections on V the submodule of OpenModuleFamily X I U Fi V cut out by OpenModuleFamilyCoherent. The scalar action restricts a ring section on V to each subopen W. Restrictions forget components outside a smaller open. This is a presheaf of modules in universe max u v w. When all these submodules are small in max u v, smallCoherentOpenModulePresheaf is its canonical sectionwise shrink, with restrictions transported by coherentOpenModuleShrinkEquiv. No cover, diagonal, or cocycle condition is assumed.

source.place: Tags 00AL (first proof) and 00AM; point-indexed universe argument of parent node

proof.text: Reindex the proof-bound components by the type of pairs (i,W) with W contained in U i and V. Transfer pointwise additive and module structures to the original family type. The restriction and overlap equations are closed under zero, addition, and scalar multiplication by semilinearity and linearity.

For W contained in V, forget the components outside W. Restriction coherence and overlap coherence are inherited verbatim. The resulting semilinear maps satisfy identity and composition componentwise. When the sections are small, apply Shrink.linearEquiv objectwise and conjugate each restriction map; the inverse identities prove functoriality.
